@capsulesCameraUnavailable.description: Shown on the camera screen when the phone has no camera.

capsulesCameraAccessDenied: Allow camera access in Settings to take a photo

@capsulesCameraAccessDenied.description: Camera screen when camera permission was denied. 'Settings' are the phone's settings.

capsulesCameraStartFailed: The camera could not be started

@capsulesCameraFlashOn.description: Accessibility label of the flash button while the flash is on.

@capsulesCameraFlashOff.description: Accessibility label of the flash button while the flash is off.

@capsulesCameraTakePhoto.description: Accessibility label of the shutter button.

@capsulesCameraSwitch.description: Accessibility label of the button that switches between the front and back camera.

@capsulesCreationTitle.description: Header title of the screen where a new capsule is set up after taking the photo.

@capsulesCreationSubmit.description: Button at the bottom of the creation screen that saves the new capsule. Keep it short.

@capsulesCreationPreview.description: Section title above the card that shows how the capsule will look.

@capsulesCreationSettings.description: Section title above the privacy, open date and colour rows.

@capsulesCreationTitleHint.description: Hint in the capsule title field (one line, large bold font, narrow: keep it very short).

@capsulesCreationDescriptionHint.description: Hint in the capsule description field.

@capsulesCreationPrivacy.description: Row title: who can see the capsule (tapping cycles Public / Friends / Private).

@capsulesCreationOpenAt.description: Row title: the day the capsule opens. The chosen date is shown next to it.

@capsulesCreationSelectDate.description: Shown in the open date row until a date is picked. Keep it short.

@capsulesCreationColor.description: Row title: the colour of the capsule's map pin (tapping cycles the colours).

@capsulesPrivacyPublic.description: Capsule visibility: everyone can see it. Agrees with 'capsule'.

@capsulesPrivacyFriends.description: Capsule visibility: only the owner's friends can see it.

@capsulesPrivacyPrivate.description: Capsule visibility: only the owner (and the friend it was sent to). Agrees with 'capsule'.

@capsulesColorRed.description: Colour of the capsule's map pin. Agrees with the word 'colour'.

@capsulesDefaultTitle.description: Title given to a capsule saved without one. It is stored with the capsule.

capsulesErrorNoLocation: We could not detect your location
capsulesErrorSavedNotSent: The capsule was saved but not sent. Tap save to try again.

@capsulesErrorSavedNotSent.description: The capsule for a friend was created but posting it to the chat failed; tapping the create button again retries.

@capsulesCommentsCount.description: Button under a capsule that opens its comments.

capsulesCommentsEmptyHint: Be the first to say something.
capsulesCommentTooLong: Comments can be up to 500 characters

@capsulesReactWith.description: Accessibility label of a reaction button.

capsulesReportSent: Thanks for telling us. The Later team will look at it.
capsulesCreationApproximateHint: About a kilometre off, not the exact spot
